faq.q: What is the deadline for ITR filing for AY 2026-27?
faq.a: For most individual taxpayers, the deadline to file Income Tax Returns for Assessment Year 2026-27 (Financial Year 2025-26) is July 31, 2026. It is advisable to file well before this date to avoid last-minute rush.

faq.q: How do these portal upgrades benefit me?
faq.a: The upgrades mean a more stable, faster, and reliable e-filing portal. You can expect quicker loading times, fewer technical glitches, and a smoother overall experience, even during peak filing periods, making your tax filing less stressful.

faq.q: Should I still verify pre-filled data, even with improvements?
faq.a: Yes, absolutely. While the accuracy of pre-filled data is expected to improve, it is crucial to cross-verify all details with your own records (Form 16, bank statements, etc.) to ensure correctness before submission.

faq.q: What if I encounter a technical issue on the upgraded portal?
faq.a: Despite upgrades, minor issues can occur. The Income Tax Department's helpdesk remains available. You can find contact details and FAQs on the official e-filing portal (incometax.gov.in) for assistance.

faq.q: Can I file my ITR using an offline utility?
faq.a: Yes, the Income Tax Department typically provides offline utilities for various ITR forms. You can download these from the e-filing portal, prepare your return offline, and then upload the generated JSON file to the portal.

faq.q: What happens if I miss the July 31st deadline?
faq.a: Missing the deadline can result in a late filing fee (up to ₹5,000 under Section 234F), loss of ability to carry forward certain losses, and potential interest under Section 234A on unpaid tax. It's always best to file on time.

faq.q: Where can I find my Annual Information Statement (AIS)?
faq.a: Your Annual Information Statement (AIS) and Taxpayer Information Summary (TIS) can be accessed by logging into the e-filing portal (incometax.gov.in), navigating to the 'Services' tab, and selecting 'Annual Information Statement (AIS)'.
